description: Rank politicians (Congress + executive branch) by estimated trading P&L across the universe. Sort by total P&L, win rate, or traded volume. P&L uses price-adjusted share estimation: disclosed amount ranges → estimated shares via historical price → FIFO on shares → open positions marked to current price. Figures are ESTIMATES (±25-40% from disclosure bracket width).
name: get_politicians_pnl_leaderboard
title: Get Politicians P&L Leaderboard
